policy: Private/non-commercial slice. Paid Kitbash3D derivatives (K044, K003, K042) are committed only as optimized real-time GLBs for this worktree. Source FBX/ZIP and external source textures are not committed. Public deployment requires a Kitbash3D EULA decision or replacement assets. AmbientCG Asphalt012 is CC0 and may be redistributed.
